app_fee.value: The graduate school says the fee varies by program; each program record gives its own fee.

fee_waiver.value: Only Fulbright and McNair Scholars get an application fee waiver; academic units may add their own.
fee_waiver.quote: Application fee waivers are granted to Fulbright Scholars and McNair Scholars.

gre_general.value: The university does not require entrance exams overall; each program sets its own rule.
gre_general.quote: While DU overall doesn’t require entrance exams

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT minimum for tests taken on or after January 21, 2026 (80 before that date).
toefl_min.quote: 4.0 for exams taken on or after January 21, 2026

english_waiver.value: Exempt only if the degree came from an institution whose sole language of instruction and examination is English; DU reviews the case and India is not named.
english_waiver.quote: Have earned a baccalaureate degree or higher from a formally-recognized/accredited university where the institution's sole language of instruction and examination is English.

notes: India is not named in the English exemption rules; an Indian English-medium degree must be checked case by case.
